---
title: "1 Corinthians"
---

# 1 Corinthians

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

1 Corinthians addresses practical problems within a growing church while emphasizing unity, holiness, love, worship, and sound doctrine. The book teaches that the gospel of Christ should transform every area of life.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 1:18</div>

<div class="identifier">The preaching of the cross</div>

### Why This Verse

Core gospel message

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses divisions within the church and emphasizes Christ as the center of unity. The key verse highlights the power and wisdom of God revealed through the message of the cross.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 2:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Eye hath not seen</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts human wisdom with spiritual wisdom. The key verse teaches that spiritual truth is understood through the Holy Spirit.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 3:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Ye are the temple of God</div>

### Why This Verse

Identity of believers

### Chapter Insight

This chapter rebukes spiritual immaturity and factionalism. The key verse reminds believers that they are God's temple and that God dwells among them.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 4:2</div>

<div class="identifier">It is required in stewards that a man be found faithful</div>

### Why This Verse

Stewardship principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter discusses faithful stewardship in ministry. The key verse emphasizes humility and accountability before God rather than seeking human approval.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 5:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Christ our Passover is sacrificed for us</div>

### Why This Verse

Christological significance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter confronts serious sin within the church. The key verse stresses the necessity of holiness and discipline within the Christian community.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 6:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Paul's most quoted teachings

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses lawsuits among believers and sexual morality. The key verse teaches that believers should glorify God with their bodies because they belong to Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 7:17</div>

<div class="identifier">As God hath distributed to every man</div>

### Why This Verse

Calling and contentment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter provides instruction regarding marriage, singleness, and contentment. The key verse emphasizes faithfulness to God in whatever situation one finds oneself.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 8:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Take heed lest your liberty become a stumbling block</div>

### Why This Verse

Christian liberty

### Chapter Insight

This chapter discusses Christian liberty and responsibility. The key verse teaches that love should govern the exercise of personal freedoms.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 9:24</div>

<div class="identifier">Run that ye may obtain</div>

### Why This Verse

Spiritual discipline

### Chapter Insight

This chapter explains Paul's willingness to sacrifice personal rights for the sake of the gospel. The key verse emphasizes becoming all things to all people in order to lead some to Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 10:13</div>

<div class="identifier">God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most memorized verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against spiritual complacency and idolatry. The key verse teaches believers to do everything for the glory of God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 11:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ</div>

### Why This Verse

Discipleship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses worship practices and the Lord's Supper. The key verse emphasizes remembering Christ's sacrifice through communion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 12:27</div>

<div class="identifier">Ye are the body of Christ</div>

### Why This Verse

Spiritual gifts and unity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches about spiritual gifts and the unity of the body of Christ. The key verse highlights that all believers are essential members of one body.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 13:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Faith, hope, charity; but the greatest of these is charity</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous "love chapter" conclusion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates the supremacy of love. The key verse teaches that love is the greatest Christian virtue and the foundation for all ministry.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 14:40</div>

<div class="identifier">Let all things be done decently and in order</div>

### Why This Verse

Church order

### Chapter Insight

This chapter provides instruction regarding orderly worship and spiritual gifts. The key verse emphasizes edification and clarity within the church.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 15:58</div>

<div class="identifier">Be ye steadfast, unmovable</div>

### Why This Verse

Resurrection chapter climax

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the resurrection of Christ and believers. The key verse declares Christ's resurrection as the foundation of Christian faith and hope.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">1 Corinthians 16:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Let all your things be done with charity</div>

### Why This Verse

Final exhortation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains final instructions, greetings, and encouragement. The key verse calls believers to remain steadfast, courageous, and strong in the Lord.
:::
